workload_distribution.definition: Named low/medium/high weighted file-type and inclusive size-range profiles in src/dataset_generator.py
workload_distribution.sampling: Deterministic from dataset_seed_base plus workload index; duplicate files reuse an original file's content and size

timing_boundaries.primary_metric: total_elapsed_ns from engine entry through operation return
timing_boundaries.verification: Independent post-operation verification is excluded from the timed interval
timing_boundaries.worker_idle_time: Estimate based on scheduler elapsed time minus callback busy time; includes coordination gaps
timing_boundaries.process_cpu: Record child-process user/kernel CPU time and utilization relative to subprocess wall time where supported

environment_metadata.cpu: Unknown; record exact processor model and logical core count before final analysis
environment_metadata.compiler: MSVC / Visual Studio 2019, C++14; exact toolset version unknown
environment_metadata.openmp_runtime: MSVC OpenMP; exact runtime version not separately identified
environment_metadata.storage_description: Local C: volume; 998,124,810,240 bytes total and 545,221,451,776 bytes available at audit on 2026-10-09; physical device and filesystem details unknown
environment_metadata.notes: Frozen settings retain the existing two-repetition matrix for comparability. CPU model, exact compiler/runtime versions, physical storage details, and cache behavior remain unknown or uncontrolled and must be recorded or reported as limitations before final analysis.

storage_plan.execution_order: complete all backup workloads while retaining generated sources, then process recovery one workload at a time
storage_plan.backup_runs: independently verify each successful backup, then remove its snapshot unless it is the selected sequential repetition-1 recovery reference
storage_plan.recovery_fixtures: prepare one isolated fixture, run its recovery measurement, retain the raw result and damage manifest, then remove the fixture before preparing the next; requires fixture-at-a-time runner support
storage_plan.recovery_reference: retain only the current workload's independently verified sequential repetition-1 snapshot; remove it after that workload's recovery measurements complete
storage_plan.capacity_gate: audit available space before each workload; do not start a workload unless source, retained reference snapshot, and peak fixture fit with operational headroom
storage_plan.staged_peak_estimate_method: Count all generated workload sources plus the largest current-workload sequential reference snapshot and one copied recovery fixture; add the configured safety margin. Remove each reference snapshot after that workload completes. Recheck against actual manifests before recovery.
